name: constant-on-time
description: A local-first interactive buck-converter and constant-on-time learning laboratory.

scripts.dev: npm run build:sim && npm run dev --workspace @constant-on-time/app
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @constant-on-time/sim-core && npm run build --workspace @constant-on-time/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sim && npm run check --workspace @constant-on-time/sim-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @constant-on-time/app
scripts.test: npm run build:sim && npm run test --workspace @constant-on-time/sim-core && npm run test --workspace @constant-on-time/app
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:sim && npm run coverage --workspace @constant-on-time/sim-core && npm run test:unit --workspace @constant-on-time/app
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run smoke
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.verify:static: npm run check:sources && npm run check:generated && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:pspice
